text.headline: CYPRUS TAX RESIDENCE: 60 DAYS ISN'T ENOUGH.
text.body: The Cyprus Tax Department says an individual may qualify under the 183-day rule or the 60-day rule. The 60-day route requires all listed conditions, including at least 60 days in Cyprus, limits on days in another country, a Cyprus business/employment/office condition and a permanent Cyprus residence.
